scope: Pinned Kali tool/package groups and eight upstream Linux CLI documentation families; not all software ever available for Linux.

research.method: Official Kali GitLab archive plus pinned upstream repository documentation; metadata and documented flags extracted without running tools.
limitations: Not a claim to enumerate every application or every option combination on every Linux release.
Reference inventory is not a list of approved Auto commands.
Versions describe the retrieved source snapshot, not the user computer.
Some source entries have no individual synopsis; missing information is not invented.
